name: Tm Visualization Suite: Composition
pitch: Show each part as a share of a whole with five proportional views.
question: What share does each part hold, and how does a second split divide it?
useWhen: Show shares when the parts add up to a whole.
features: Read each share of a whole on a fixed 0 to 100% scale.
Count each share in equal squares in a waffle.
Place one glyph for each unit in a group for each category.
Show how two splits share a whole in a marimekko.
See how volume flows between two splits in parallel sets.
Use the Qlik total of the current selection as the denominator.

hero.alt: 100% stacked bar of order count by channel, with each bar split into delivery methods by color.

screenshots.alt: Waffle chart of order count by customer segment, with equal squares for each segment.
screenshots.caption: Read each share as a count of squares.

screenshots.alt: Marimekko chart of regional sales, with column width and cell height for two shares.
screenshots.caption: See how two splits share one whole.
